fields.name: CollectionMapAttributeBase property mapping attribute
fields.contract: CollectionMapAttributeBase is an abstract Attribute with no public constructor: its sole constructor is protected and takes the structured parameter's name, so only a derived collection-mapping attribute (never this base type itself) can be applied to a property. The name supplied at construction is exposed afterward through the read-only ParameterName property and does not change once set. A derived attribute must implement the sole abstract operation, AppendCollectionInParameterExpressions, to append expression-tree nodes that add the decorated collection property as a structured parameter for a given element type; the base type declares no corresponding read-direction operation, so producing a collection property's value from query results is not part of this attribute's contract.
